Function for finding significant bimodal peaks
```{r}
find_bimodal_peaks_significant <- function(x,
                                           min_peak_distance = 1,
                                           min_valley_drop = 0,
                                           bw = "nrd0") {
  # Compute density
  dens <- density(x, bw = bw)
  
  dx <- mean(diff(dens$x))
  min_distance_idx <- ceiling(min_peak_distance / dx)
  
  # Detect all peaks with essentially no height cutoff
  peaks <- findpeaks(dens$y, minpeakheight = 0, minpeakdistance = min_distance_idx)
  
  # If fewer than 2 peaks detected, return NA
  if (is.null(peaks) || nrow(peaks) < 2) {
    return(data.frame(left_peak = NA, left_y = NA,
                      right_peak = NA, right_y = NA,
                      n_peaks = ifelse(is.null(peaks), 0, nrow(peaks))))
  }
  
  # Get x and y positions of all peaks
  peak_x <- dens$x[peaks[,2]]
  peak_y <- peaks[,1]
  
  # Compute peak prominence (peak height minus minimum valley between neighboring peaks)
  prominences <- numeric(length(peak_y))
  for (i in seq_along(peak_y)) {
    left_valley <- if (i == 1) min(dens$y[1:peaks[i,2]]) else min(dens$y[peaks[i-1,2]:peaks[i,2]])
    right_valley <- if (i == length(peak_y)) min(dens$y[peaks[i,2]:length(dens$y)]) else min(dens$y[peaks[i,2]:peaks[i+1,2]])
    prominences[i] <- peak_y[i] - max(left_valley, right_valley)
  }
  
  # Pick top 2 peaks by prominence
  top_idx <- order(prominences, decreasing = TRUE)[1:2]
  top_peaks_x <- peak_x[top_idx]
  top_peaks_y <- peak_y[top_idx]
  
  # Assign left/right based on x position
  left_peak <- top_peaks_x[which.min(top_peaks_x)]
  left_y <- top_peaks_y[which.min(top_peaks_x)]
  right_peak <- top_peaks_x[which.max(top_peaks_x)]
  right_y <- top_peaks_y[which.max(top_peaks_x)]
  
  # Optional valley check between the two selected peaks
  if (min_valley_drop > 0) {
    valley_range <- dens$x >= left_peak & dens$x <= right_peak
    valley_y <- min(dens$y[valley_range])
    min_allowed_valley <- min(left_y, right_y) * (1 - min_valley_drop)
    
    if (valley_y > min_allowed_valley) {
      return(data.frame(left_peak = NA, left_y = NA,
                        right_peak = NA, right_y = NA, n_peaks = nrow(peaks)))
    }
  }
  
  data.frame(left_peak, left_y, right_peak, right_y, n_peaks = nrow(peaks))
}

```
Functions for finding cutoffs (GO86 done separately)
```{r}
find_bimodal_cutoff_go86 <- function(x, bw = "nrd0",
                                      lower_frac = 0.1,  # 10% of (right-left)
                                      upper_frac = 0.1,  # 10% of (right-left)
                                      min_buffer = 0,     # optional floor
                                      max_buffer = Inf) { # optional cap
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) < 2) {
    return(data.frame(left_peak = NA, right_peak = NA, cutoff = NA,
                      lower_cutoff = NA, upper_cutoff = NA,
                      lower_buffer = NA, upper_buffer = NA))
  }
  dens <- density(x, bw = bw)
  y <- dens$y
  x_vals <- dens$x
  # local maxima indices
  peaks_idx <- which(diff(sign(diff(y))) == -2) + 1
  # require exactly 2 peaks
  if (length(peaks_idx) != 2) {
    return(data.frame(left_peak = NA, right_peak = NA, cutoff = NA,
                      lower_cutoff = NA, upper_cutoff = NA,
                      lower_buffer = NA, upper_buffer = NA))
  }
  
  left_peak  <- x_vals[peaks_idx[1]]
  right_peak <- x_vals[peaks_idx[2]]
  
  between_idx <- which(x_vals > left_peak & x_vals < right_peak)
  if (length(between_idx) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(left_peak = left_peak, right_peak = right_peak, cutoff = NA,
                      lower_cutoff = NA, upper_cutoff = NA,
                      lower_buffer = NA, upper_buffer = NA))
  }
  
  cutoff <- x_vals[between_idx[which.min(y[between_idx])]]
  
  # --- relative buffers based on peak separation ---
  sep <- right_peak - left_peak
  lower_buffer <- sep * lower_frac
  upper_buffer <- sep * upper_frac
  
  # optional clamp
  lower_buffer <- max(min_buffer, min(max_buffer, lower_buffer))
  upper_buffer <- max(min_buffer, min(max_buffer, upper_buffer))
  
  lower_cutoff <- cutoff - lower_buffer
  upper_cutoff <- cutoff + upper_buffer
  
  data.frame(left_peak, right_peak, cutoff,
             lower_cutoff, upper_cutoff,
             lower_buffer, upper_buffer)
}


####### classify local minima between the peaks, with relative buffers
find_bimodal_cutoff_strict <- function(x, bw = "nrd0",
                                      lower_frac = 0.50,  # 10% of (right-left)
                                      upper_frac = 0.50,  # 10% of (right-left)
                                      min_buffer = 0,     # optional floor
                                      max_buffer = Inf) { # optional cap
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) < 2) {
    return(data.frame(left_peak = NA, right_peak = NA, cutoff = NA,
                      lower_cutoff = NA, upper_cutoff = NA,
                      lower_buffer = NA, upper_buffer = NA))
  }
  dens <- density(x, bw = bw)
  y <- dens$y
  x_vals <- dens$x
  # local maxima indices
  peaks_idx <- which(diff(sign(diff(y))) == -2) + 1
  # require exactly 2 peaks
  if (length(peaks_idx) != 2) {
    return(data.frame(left_peak = NA, right_peak = NA, cutoff = NA,
                      lower_cutoff = NA, upper_cutoff = NA,
                      lower_buffer = NA, upper_buffer = NA))
  }
  
  left_peak  <- x_vals[peaks_idx[1]]
  right_peak <- x_vals[peaks_idx[2]]
  
  between_idx <- which(x_vals > left_peak & x_vals < right_peak)
  if (length(between_idx) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(left_peak = left_peak, right_peak = right_peak, cutoff = NA,
                      lower_cutoff = NA, upper_cutoff = NA,
                      lower_buffer = NA, upper_buffer = NA))
  }
  
  cutoff <- x_vals[between_idx[which.min(y[between_idx])]]
  
  # --- relative buffers based on peak separation ---
  sep <- right_peak - left_peak
  lower_buffer <- sep * lower_frac
  upper_buffer <- sep * upper_frac
  
  # optional clamp
  lower_buffer <- max(min_buffer, min(max_buffer, lower_buffer))
  upper_buffer <- max(min_buffer, min(max_buffer, upper_buffer))
  
  lower_cutoff <- cutoff - lower_buffer
  upper_cutoff <- cutoff + upper_buffer
  
  data.frame(left_peak, right_peak, cutoff,
             lower_cutoff, upper_cutoff,
             lower_buffer, upper_buffer)
}

```

Calculate significant bimodal peaks
```{r}
# Calculate peaks for each stack name using local maxima finding
peaks_df <- data %>%
  group_by(stack_name, experiment) %>%
  filter(n() >= 2) %>%
  summarize(peaks = list(find_bimodal_peaks_significant(edu_int)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  unnest(peaks)

peaks_df_clean <- na.omit(peaks_df)

clean_data <- data %>%
  inner_join(peaks_df_clean, by = c("stack_name", "experiment"))
```
Calculate cutoffs
```{r}
#cutoffs per stack
cutoffs_df_go86 <- filter(clean_data, experiment == 86) %>%
  group_by(stack_name) %>%
  summarize(cutoffs = list(find_bimodal_cutoff_go86(edu_int)), 
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  unnest(cutoffs)

#cutoffs per stack
cutoffs_df_all <- filter(clean_data, experiment != 86) %>%
  group_by(stack_name) %>%
  summarize(cutoffs = list(find_bimodal_cutoff_strict(edu_int)), 
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  unnest(cutoffs)

cutoffs_df <- bind_rows(cutoffs_df_go86, cutoffs_df_all) %>%
  filter(!is.na(left_peak))
```

Assign EdU intensity to bottom or top tables
```{r}
df_bottom <- clean_data %>%
  inner_join(cutoffs_df, by = "stack_name") %>%
  filter(edu_int < lower_cutoff)

df_top <- clean_data %>%
  inner_join(cutoffs_df, by = "stack_name") %>%
  filter(edu_int > upper_cutoff)
```

Figure 5D
```{r}
####Make Basic Figure (n =5)

# 1. Define antibodies of interest
antibodies_of_interest <- c("G9a", "WIZ", "H3K9me3", "H3K9me2")

# 2. Subset data
df_subset <- df_top %>%
  filter(
    antibody %in% antibodies_of_interest,
    clone == "32",
    condition %in% c("Veh", "HU", "post-rep DNA"),
    experiment %in% c(86,84,108,102,118)
  )

#df_subset$condition <- as.character(df_subset$condition)
df_subset$condition <- factor(df_subset$condition, levels = c("Veh", "HU", "post-rep DNA"))

# 3. Run pairwise Wilcoxon tests by antibody
stat_test <- df_subset %>%
  group_by(antibody) %>%
  pairwise_wilcox_test(pla_ct ~ condition, p.adjust.method = "BH") %>%
  add_y_position() %>% 
  ungroup()
  
# Optional: keep only nice significance labels
stat_test <- stat_test %>%
  mutate(
    p.adj.signif = case_when(
      p.adj < 0.0001 ~ "****",
      p.adj < 0.001  ~ "***",
      p.adj < 0.01   ~ "**",
      TRUE             ~ "ns"
    )
  )

stat_test$y.position <- c(67.5, 75, 82.5, 120,135,150, 120, 135,150, 105, 120, 135)

# 4. Plot with significance bars
p = ggplot(df_subset, aes(x = condition, y = pla_ct, fill = condition)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 1) +
  #geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 0.2, alpha = 0.5) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(
    stat_test,
    label = "p.adj.signif",
    tip.length = 0.01,
    hide.ns = FALSE,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 6
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~antibody, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    y = "Adjusted PLA Foci Count",
    x = "Condition"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Veh" = "lightsteelblue1",
    "HU" = "lightsteelblue3",
    "post-rep DNA" = "steelblue1"
  )) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 20) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.65)) + theme(
  panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
)
p

# Count number of individual points in each boxplot
point_counts <- df_subset %>%
  group_by(antibody, condition) %>%
  summarise(
    n = sum(!is.na(pla_ct)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

point_counts
```
